operational_definition: Capacity to solve novel problems by inducing rules and drawing logical conclusions from premises, minimally dependent on prior knowledge.
observable_behaviours: Detects patterns in new data; reasons through unfamiliar problems step-by-step; forms and tests hypotheses.
related_constructs: Quantitative Reasoning; Cognitive Flexibility; Problem Sensitivity
distinction_from_related_constructs: Reasoning about novel material, not applying stored knowledge (contrast Verbal Comprehension) and not number-specific (contrast Quantitative Reasoning).
assessment_approaches: Performance-based reasoning tests (matrix/series/figural and verbal reasoning) by qualified practitioners; no instrument endorsed here.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Performance depends on test format and cultural/educational loading; O*NET ratings describe job requirements, not a person's score.

operational_definition: Capacity to reason with numbers, mathematical relations and algorithms, and to choose appropriate mathematical methods.
observable_behaviours: Selects correct formula/method; checks plausibility of numeric results; reasons with ratios, probabilities and models.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Reasoning quality with quantitative material, not speed of arithmetic (Processing Speed) nor stored maths knowledge alone.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based numerical reasoning assessments under qualified administration.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Confounded by maths education/anxiety; calculator/tool context changes job relevance.

operational_definition: Capacity to understand spoken and written language, vocabulary and ideas presented verbally.
observable_behaviours: Paraphrases complex text accurately; follows briefings; extracts meaning from documentation.
related_constructs: Verbal Expression; Long-Term Learning and Retrieval
distinction_from_related_constructs: Receptive understanding, not producing language (Verbal Expression) and not general reasoning with novel non-verbal material.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based reading/listening comprehension and vocabulary measures.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Language- and culture-loaded; must not be assessed in a language the person cannot fairly use.

operational_definition: Capacity to communicate information and ideas in speech and writing so others understand.
observable_behaviours: Writes clear reports/emails; explains technical content to non-specialists; structures presentations.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Productive communication ability, not comprehension, and not willingness to socialise (Extraversion) or a trained writing skill alone.
assessment_approaches: Work-sample and performance-based written/oral communication assessment; rated exercises.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Overlaps trained literacy/job knowledge; accent/dialect must never be scored as low ability.

operational_definition: Capacity to encode, maintain and manipulate information in immediate awareness while resisting distraction.
observable_behaviours: Holds instructions while acting; updates figures mid-task; resumes after interruption without losing place.
related_constructs: Selective Attention and Attentional Control; Long-Term Learning and Retrieval
distinction_from_related_constructs: Short-term maintenance/manipulation (seconds), not long-term storage/retrieval and not attention alone.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based working-memory tasks (e.g. complex span paradigms) by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: No single brief task measures the whole construct; anxiety and sleep affect scores.

operational_definition: Capacity to learn, store, consolidate and retrieve information over minutes to years, including fluent retrieval of ideas.
observable_behaviours: Recalls procedures after delay; learns from training and applies later; retrieves relevant facts fluently.
related_constructs: Working Memory; Intellectual Curiosity (P-catalogue personality/motivation neighbour)
distinction_from_related_constructs: Retention/retrieval over delay, not immediate manipulation (Working Memory) and not desire to learn (curiosity is motivational).
assessment_approaches: Performance-based learning/recall paradigms; training-learning outcomes with controls.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: O*NET Memorization is narrower than CHC Glr; prior knowledge strongly affects observed learning.

operational_definition: Capacity to perform simple cognitive/perceptual tasks quickly and accurately under time pressure.
observable_behaviours: Rapidly scans, compares and checks material; sustains speed without error growth.
related_constructs: Psychomotor Dexterity and Reaction Speed; Selective Attention
distinction_from_related_constructs: Speed on simple tasks, not reasoning quality on complex novel problems and not motor speed of limbs.
assessment_approaches: Timed performance tests with accuracy jointly scored.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Speed-accuracy trade-off and age/norm effects; speed alone must not be equated with competence.

operational_definition: Capacity to form, rotate and manipulate visual-spatial representations and judge spatial relations.
observable_behaviours: Reads diagrams/plans; mentally rotates components; imagines assembly or layout outcomes.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Internal spatial manipulation, not visual acuity, not manual skill, and not artistic interest/ability.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based spatial tests (rotation/visualisation paradigms).
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Relevance is highly job-specific; test familiarity and 2D/3D format matter.

operational_definition: Capacity to shift rules, categories and strategies as conditions change and to generate alternative categorisations.
observable_behaviours: Switches approach when data changes; reclassifies problems; abandons failing strategy appropriately.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Measured cognitive shifting capacity, not self-reported willingness to accept workplace change (Adaptability, a work style).
theoretical_framework: CHC executive-function literature; O*NET Category Flexibility
assessment_approaches: Performance-based set-shifting tasks; structured behavioural exercises.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Executive-function tasks have modest ecological validity; distinction from Adaptability must be enforced in mapping.

operational_definition: Capacity to generate original, useful ideas and multiple candidate solutions to open problems.
observable_behaviours: Produces varied solution options; combines concepts in novel ways; proposes testable innovations.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Cognitive generation capacity/performance, not trait openness, not workplace innovation tendency, and not Artistic interest.
theoretical_framework: CHC Glr retrieval fluency/originality; O*NET Originality/Fluency of Ideas
assessment_approaches: Divergent-thinking performance tasks and expert-rated work samples; criteria must be pre-specified.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Scoring originality is rater-dependent; domain knowledge constrains creative output; do not use novelty alone without usefulness.

operational_definition: Capacity to recognise when something is wrong or likely to go wrong, and to identify the relevant problem.
observable_behaviours: Notices anomalies/risks early; flags inconsistencies; frames issues before escalation.
related_constructs: Fluid Reasoning; Attention to Detail (personality facet)
distinction_from_related_constructs: Detecting that a problem exists, not solving it (Fluid Reasoning) and not trait carefulness (Attention to Detail).
theoretical_framework: O*NET Idea Generation and Reasoning abilities
assessment_approaches: Performance-based error/anomaly detection exercises and work samples.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: O*NET element is an occupational descriptor, not by itself a validated test construct; validate any measure independently.

operational_definition: Capacity to focus on task-relevant information, sustain concentration and suppress distractors.
observable_behaviours: Maintains accuracy amid interruptions/alerts; monitors dashboards without missing critical signals.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Attentional selection/control, not memory capacity itself and not mere processing speed.
theoretical_framework: CHC Gwm attentional control; O*NET Selective Attention/Time Sharing
assessment_approaches: Performance-based attention tasks; observed performance in standardised simulations.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Fatigue, environment and neurodivergence affect assessment; accommodations and fairness review required.

operational_definition: Capacity to detect regularities and arrange information/actions according to a rule or set of rules.
observable_behaviours: Sequences steps correctly; spots trends/recurring faults; applies classification rules consistently.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Applying/detecting order and regularities in presented material; broader novel inference belongs to Fluid Reasoning.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based sequencing/classification exercises and work samples.
measurement_cautions: Scores are test- and norm-dependent; use only validated instruments, qualified administration, and fairness/accommodation review. Never infer from O*NET occupational ratings.
limitations: Partly redundant with Fluid Reasoning — reviewer must decide if retained as separate domain in scoring (see overlap report).

operational_definition: Capacity for fine manual dexterity, control precision and rapid, accurate response to signals.
observable_behaviours: Assembles/manipulates small components accurately; reacts promptly and correctly to alarms/signals.
related_constructs: Processing Speed; Physical Capability (not separately catalogued)
distinction_from_related_constructs: Motor execution and reaction, not cognitive processing speed alone; physical strength/stamina are excluded and not psychometric substitutes.
theoretical_framework: O*NET Psychomotor/Reaction abilities; CHC psychomotor/speed domains
assessment_approaches: Standardised performance/motor tests and job simulations where job-related and safe.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Must only be used where demonstrably job-related; disability fairness and safety review essential.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: General tendency toward organisation, self-discipline, dutifulness and goal-directed behaviour.
observable_behaviours: Plans and completes work reliably; follows through; keeps quality standards without supervision.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Broad trait; Dependability/Achievement Orientation/Self-Control are narrower facets or neighbours, not synonyms — do not double-count in later scoring.
theoretical_framework: Big Five / FFM; Zell & Lesick synthesis
assessment_approaches: Validated multi-item personality inventories administered and interpreted by qualified practitioners; specific instruments require independent verification.
measurement_cautions: Self/observer report; modest criterion associations; not for sole selection decisions; consider faking, culture and context.
limitations: Self-report faking/coaching possible; modest average performance associations (conscientiousness rho~.20 for job performance in S006) — never a sole selection criterion.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: General tendency toward sociability, assertiveness, activity and positive emotionality in social engagement.
observable_behaviours: Initiates interaction; speaks up in groups; engages stakeholders energetically.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Trait tendency, not communication ability, leadership competence, or job performance itself.
assessment_approaches: Validated personality inventories (self/observer report) by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Self/observer report; modest criterion associations; not for sole selection decisions; consider faking, culture and context.
limitations: High extraversion is not universally desirable; cultural display rules affect expression and ratings.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: General tendency toward compassion, respectfulness and cooperation versus antagonism.
observable_behaviours: Handles disagreement constructively; considers others' interests; maintains working relationships.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Broad trait; Empathy is a specific capacity/tendency, Cooperation a work-style facet, Honesty-Humility a distinct HEXACO factor.
assessment_approaches: Validated personality inventories (self/observer report).
measurement_cautions: Self/observer report; modest criterion associations; not for sole selection decisions; consider faking, culture and context.
limitations: Agreeableness does not imply inability to negotiate or give critical feedback.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to experience low negative affect and remain calm under stress (inverse pole of Neuroticism).
observable_behaviours: Stays composed in incidents; recovers quickly from setbacks; does not ruminate excessively.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Trait affect tendency, not a regulation skill/strategy (Emotion Regulation) and not situational coping outcome (Stress Tolerance).
theoretical_framework: Big Five Neuroticism (inverse); HEXACO Emotionality (related, not identical)
assessment_approaches: Validated personality inventories by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Self/observer report; modest criterion associations; not for sole selection decisions; consider faking, culture and context.
limitations: Never use as a proxy mental-health screen; clinical interpretation is out of scope.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: General tendency toward intellectual curiosity, imagination and preference for novelty and ideas.
observable_behaviours: Explores new methods; engages abstract ideas; questions assumptions constructively.
related_constructs: Intellectual Curiosity (work style in catalogue overlap set); Creativity and Originality
distinction_from_related_constructs: Broad trait preference, not creative performance, learning ability, or willingness to accept a specific organisational change.
assessment_approaches: Validated personality inventories (self/observer report).
measurement_cautions: Self/observer report; modest criterion associations; not for sole selection decisions; consider faking, culture and context.
limitations: Overlap with P-catalogue curiosity/creativity domains requires reviewer decision on facet vs broad-trait scoring.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to be sincere, fair, modest and uninterested in exploiting others or displaying status/wealth.
observable_behaviours: Declines manipulative tactics; credits others; acts fairly when unobserved.
distinction_from_related_constructs: HEXACO factor distinct from Big Five Agreeableness; Integrity in this catalogue is the narrower work-behaviour tendency.
assessment_approaches: Validated HEXACO-based inventories by qualified practitioners; no scoring details reproduced here.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Situational incentives also drive ethical behaviour; trait score must not be treated as a lie detector or character verdict.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to be reliable, responsible and consistent in fulfilling obligations at work.
observable_behaviours: Meets commitments; attends reliably; completes assigned work to agreed standard.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Work-focused facet of conscientiousness, retained separately only because O*NET rates it distinctly — flag for double-counting review.
theoretical_framework: O*NET Work Styles (Dependability); Big Five facet literature
assessment_approaches: Validated personality/work-style inventories; supervisor/observer ratings with behavioural anchors.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Observer ratings can reflect opportunity/context, not only trait; broad-vs-facet duplication must be resolved before scoring.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to set challenging goals, maintain high standards and exert effort toward them.
observable_behaviours: Sets stretch targets; persists on goals; seeks measurable improvement.
related_constructs: Autonomous Work Motivation; Perseverance and Grit; Conscientiousness
distinction_from_related_constructs: Trait goal-striving tendency; distinct from intrinsic enjoyment (Autonomous Motivation) and long-term passion/consistency (Grit).
theoretical_framework: O*NET Work Styles; Big Five industriousness facet
assessment_approaches: Validated inventories and structured behavioural evidence; goal records interpreted in context.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Goal difficulty and resources vary by job; do not penalise people for context-set targets.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to act proactively, take on responsibilities beyond the minimum and start action without prompting.
observable_behaviours: Volunteers for problems; anticipates needs; starts improvements within authority.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Self-starting tendency, not formal leadership, decision authority, or extraversion alone.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; behavioural examples rated against anchors.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Proactivity can be constrained by role authority/culture; absence of opportunity is not absence of trait.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to be open to and comfortable with change, new experiences and shifting priorities at work.
observable_behaviours: Adjusts plans when priorities change; learns new tools willingly; works with revised processes.
related_constructs: Cognitive Flexibility; Openness to Experience; Tolerance for Ambiguity (not separately catalogued)
distinction_from_related_constructs: Self-reported/behavioural openness to workplace change, not measured cognitive shifting capacity and not comfort with unclear information alone.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; change-scenario behavioural assessment.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Change quality/communication affects behaviour; do not label resistance to poorly managed change as low adaptability.

construct_family: Personality traits and behavioural work styles
operational_definition: Tendency to behave ethically, honestly and consistently with stated rules and commitments at work.
observable_behaviours: Reports errors honestly; follows controls; raises concerns through proper channels.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Observable work-behaviour tendency; Honesty-Humility is the broader personality factor including modesty/greed avoidance.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; structured integrity-related behavioural evidence — any dedicated integrity test requires separate validation/legal review.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: High legal/ethical sensitivity; never infer dishonesty from a low proxy rating; O*NET WI/DR are occupational ratings, not person measures.

operational_definition: Capacity to influence which emotions one has, when, and how they are experienced/expressed, e.g. via reappraisal or response modulation.
observable_behaviours: Reframes setbacks; pauses before reacting; recovers focus after criticism.
related_constructs: Ability Emotional Intelligence; Self-Control; Emotional Stability
distinction_from_related_constructs: A process/skill that can be deployed by people of any trait stability level; not the same as perceiving/understanding emotions (Ability EI).
theoretical_framework: Gross process model of emotion regulation
assessment_approaches: Performance/scenario-based assessment and validated self-report of regulation strategies, interpreted by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Strategy adaptiveness is context-dependent; suppression is not uniformly maladaptive; cultural display norms matter.

operational_definition: Ability to perceive, use, understand and manage emotions in self and others, assessed as maximal performance.
observable_behaviours: Identifies emotions from cues; predicts emotional trajectories; chooses regulation-relevant responses in scenarios.
related_constructs: Trait Emotional Intelligence; Empathy; Social Perceptiveness
distinction_from_related_constructs: Performance ability with right/better answers by model criteria — fundamentally different method and construct from self-perceived Trait EI; they correlate only weakly.
assessment_approaches: Performance-based EI tests only (self-report does not measure ability EI); qualified administration.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Scoring keys are model/expert/consensus-dependent and proprietary instruments must not be reproduced; job relevance must be shown per role.

operational_definition: Self-perceived emotion-related dispositions and emotional self-efficacy (how people typically believe they perceive/express/regulate emotions).
observable_behaviours: Reports confidence handling emotional situations; describes typical emotional reactions.
related_constructs: Ability Emotional Intelligence; Self-Confidence and Self-Efficacy
distinction_from_related_constructs: Self-perception, not demonstrated emotion ability; must never be reported as Ability EI or substituted for it.
assessment_approaches: Validated self-report trait-EI questionnaires by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Self-report bias; overlapping variance with Big Five traits requires incremental-validity review before any use.

operational_definition: Tendency to accept criticism and deal calmly with high-stress situations, and to recover functioning after adversity.
observable_behaviours: Maintains performance in incidents; seeks support appropriately; recovers after failures.
related_constructs: Emotional Stability; Emotion Regulation; Perseverance and Grit
distinction_from_related_constructs: Work-situated tolerance/recovery, not trait negative-affect level alone and not long-term goal perseverance; resilience is partly contextual, not purely a trait.
theoretical_framework: O*NET Work Styles (Stress Tolerance); resilience literature (review required)
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; behavioural evidence in simulations with welfare safeguards.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Do not use to justify exposing people to excessive stress or to screen out people with health conditions; organisational stressors must be assessed too.

operational_definition: Tendency to keep emotions in check, control anger and avoid aggressive behaviour even in difficult situations, and to inhibit impulses.
observable_behaviours: Pauses before responding in conflict; follows process under provocation; manages impulses to act hastily.
distinction_from_related_constructs: O*NET Self-Control is a narrow work style; Emotion Regulation is the broader process repertoire; impulse control also relates to conscientiousness facets.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; scenario/behavioural assessment.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Suppression of expression must not be confused with healthy regulation; context and provocation matter.

operational_definition: Belief in one's capability to organise and execute work actions and control work-related outcomes.
observable_behaviours: Attempts challenging tasks; persists after initial failure; backs judgement with evidence.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Capability belief (domain/task-specific in Bandura's theory), not sociability, actual ability, or arrogance; global confidence measures are weaker.
theoretical_framework: Bandura self-efficacy (via Gross/Bandura search evidence); O*NET Self-Confidence
assessment_approaches: Task-specific self-efficacy scales developed per Bandura guidance; generic confidence items are provisional.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Self-efficacy is task-specific — a single global score should not be mapped to all jobs; inflated confidence is not competence.

operational_definition: Perseverance and passion for long-term goals: sustained effort and maintained interest over time despite setbacks.
observable_behaviours: Continues effort over months; returns after setbacks; maintains goal focus.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Long-term effort+interest consistency; highly correlated with Conscientiousness — incremental value disputed and must be reviewed, not assumed.
assessment_approaches: Validated grit self-report scales by qualified practitioners; behavioural persistence evidence.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Original grit accounted for ~4% variance in success outcomes and overlaps conscientiousness; do not double-count both without reviewer approval.

operational_definition: Tendency and capacity to understand and share others' feelings, be sensitive to needs, and take others' perspectives.
observable_behaviours: Notices distress; listens and checks understanding; adjusts approach to others' needs.
related_constructs: Social Perceptiveness; Ability Emotional Intelligence; Agreeableness
distinction_from_related_constructs: Empathy centres on feeling/perspective response to others; Social Perceptiveness is broader awareness of reactions/why; EI is a wider ability set.
assessment_approaches: Validated empathy self/observer measures; performance perspective-taking tasks where validated.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Affective vs cognitive empathy are sub-facets, not separate catalogue domains; empathy does not guarantee effective helping behaviour.

operational_definition: Capacity to be aware of others' reactions and understand why they react as they do.
observable_behaviours: Reads meeting dynamics; anticipates stakeholder concerns; detects misunderstanding early.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Cognitive awareness/understanding of social reactions, not necessarily feeling with the person (Empathy) and not a full EI battery.
theoretical_framework: O*NET abilities/skills descriptors (via Content Model); social cognition literature
assessment_approaches: Performance-based social-cognition scenarios; observer-rated exercises.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: O*NET treats related content largely as skill/ability descriptors; any test needs independent validation. Do not equate with mind-reading accuracy claims.

operational_definition: Tendency to be pleasant, helpful and willing to assist and work jointly with others.
observable_behaviours: Shares information; helps overloaded colleagues; contributes to joint outcomes.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Specific cooperative work tendency; Agreeableness is broader and includes compassion/respect facets.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; team exercises with multiple raters.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Team behaviour depends on incentives/team context; individual score must not be blamed for team failure.

operational_definition: Tendency to lead, take charge, offer opinions and provide direction to others at work.
observable_behaviours: Coordinates others in ambiguity; makes and communicates decisions; takes accountability.
related_constructs: Initiative and Proactivity; Extraversion; Verbal Expression
distinction_from_related_constructs: Willingness/tendency to direct others, not leadership competence, performance, or formal authority; ability/skill components are assessed separately.
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; assessment-centre exercises with trained raters for competence claims.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Never equate orientation with leadership effectiveness; context, competence and ethics are separate.

operational_definition: Tendency to approach disagreement calmly, negotiate and seek workable resolutions rather than avoid or escalate.
observable_behaviours: Raises issues directly and respectfully; explores interests; agrees next steps in disputes.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Catalogued as an orientation/tendency only; negotiation itself is a trained skill, not a trait — reviewer must confirm construct boundary.
theoretical_framework: O*NET Work Activities (Resolving Conflicts — proxy only); interpersonal literature (review required)
assessment_approaches: Scenario-based exercises and observer ratings; self-report alone insufficient.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Weakest-evidence interpersonal domain; O*NET link is a work activity (behaviour demanded by job), not a psychometric element — proxy only.

operational_definition: Tendency to actively look for ways to help people and meet service users' needs.
observable_behaviours: Checks user needs; follows up on requests; designs help around the recipient.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Work tendency to help; Social interest is preference for helping-type work, Empathy is feeling/perspective capacity — related but not identical.
theoretical_framework: O*NET Work Styles/Activities descriptors (proxy); Holland Social (related)
assessment_approaches: Work-style inventories; service-scenario behavioural assessment.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: In O*NET 31.0 this appears mainly via work activities/styles neighbours, not a same-name element; mapping is proxy and needs reviewer confirmation.

operational_definition: Degree to which work behaviour is driven by interest, enjoyment and fully endorsed values (autonomous/intrinsic motivation) rather than pressure or reward alone.
observable_behaviours: Chooses challenging interesting tasks; sustains effort without close monitoring; endorses purpose of work.
related_constructs: Achievement Orientation; Learning and Mastery Orientation
distinction_from_related_constructs: Quality of motivation (why one acts), not amount of effort, goal ambition, or perseverance over years.
assessment_approaches: Validated work-motivation self-report based on SDT regulation types, by qualified practitioners.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Motivation is partly state/context (autonomy support matters); a person score must not be used to excuse poor job design.

operational_definition: Tendency to pursue competence, understanding and improvement (mastery goals) rather than only demonstrating performance or avoiding failure.
observable_behaviours: Seeks feedback; practises difficult skills; treats errors as information.
related_constructs: Intellectual Curiosity neighbours; Achievement Orientation; Openness to Experience
distinction_from_related_constructs: Goal orientation toward mastery; distinct from trait curiosity/openness and from achievement striving for standards/recognition.
theoretical_framework: Goal-orientation literature; SDT competence need (related); O*NET Intellectual Curiosity (proxy)
assessment_approaches: Validated goal-orientation self-report; learning-behaviour evidence.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Mastery/performance goal constructs have evolved (approach/avoidance); reviewer must fix the exact model before instrument choice.

operational_definition: Degree to which a person values work that serves others/society and prioritises collective benefit.
observable_behaviours: Chooses service-improving options; weighs community impact; volunteers effort for shared benefit.
related_constructs: Service Orientation; Agreeableness; Social vocational interest
distinction_from_related_constructs: A value (what is prized), not helping behaviour frequency, empathic capacity, or interest in social occupations alone.
theoretical_framework: Work-values literature; SDT relatedness (related); Holland Social (related)
assessment_approaches: Validated work-values inventories (rank/rate values) — instrument must be independently verified.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: Values predict choice/satisfaction more than ability/performance; O*NET 31.0 files used here contain no direct work-values element — see crosswalk no_match.

operational_definition: Degree to which a person values discretion, independence and control over how work is done.
observable_behaviours: Seeks ownership of methods; works effectively with low supervision; raises over-control issues constructively.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Valuing independence is not the same as being intrinsically motivated by the task, nor as proactive behaviour.
assessment_approaches: Validated work-values inventories.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: No direct O*NET element in the audited 31.0 tables; do not infer from occupation autonomy context ratings without a separate, reviewed bridge.

operational_definition: Degree to which a person values pay, recognition, advancement and status outcomes from work.
observable_behaviours: Responds to incentives/recognition; seeks advancement; negotiates rewards.
related_constructs: Achievement Orientation; Honesty-Humility (greed avoidance, inverse neighbour)
distinction_from_related_constructs: Extrinsic outcome valuing, not ambition/standards alone and not low honesty-humility; valuing reward is not unethical.
theoretical_framework: Work-values / extrinsic motivation (SDT controlled regulation, related)
assessment_approaches: Validated work-values and motivation inventories.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: No direct O*NET element; socially desirable responding is strong — provisional pending reviewer-approved construct definition.

operational_definition: Degree to which a person values predictability, clear procedures, stability and job security.
observable_behaviours: Prefers defined processes; plans for contingencies; values stable employment conditions.
related_constructs: Conscientiousness; Adaptability (inverse neighbour); Conventional vocational interest
distinction_from_related_constructs: A value preference for structure/security, not trait orderliness, dislike of change, or Conventional interest in data/procedures — though correlated in practice.
assessment_approaches: Validated work-values inventories.
measurement_cautions: Use only validated instruments with qualified interpretation; O*NET occupational ratings (IM/LV/OI/DR/WI) describe jobs, not people, and must never be reported as a person's score.
limitations: No direct O*NET element; provisional — reviewer must decide whether values domains are scored alongside traits at all in later phases.

operational_definition: Interest in practical, hands-on work with tools, machines, materials, plants/animals or outdoor/physical activity.
observable_behaviours: Chooses building/repair/technical-practical activities; enjoys operating equipment.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Interest/preference only — says nothing about dexterity, strength or competence.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC interest inventories (self-report of preferences).
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: Interest fit predicts choice/satisfaction, not job performance ability; never use as an ability screen.

operational_definition: Interest in researching, analysing and solving intellectual, scientific or data problems.
observable_behaviours: Chooses inquiry/analysis activities; enjoys theory, data and experimentation.
related_constructs: Fluid Reasoning (ability neighbour); Openness to Experience
distinction_from_related_constructs: Preference for investigative work, not reasoning ability or trait openness.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC inventories.
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: As P045: interest is not ability.

operational_definition: Interest in creative, expressive and design work in visual, performing, literary or applied arts.
observable_behaviours: Chooses original design/performance/writing activities; values aesthetic expression.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Preference for artistic work, not creative ability or openness trait.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC inventories.
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: As P045: interest is not ability.

operational_definition: Interest in helping, teaching, advising, caring for or serving others.
observable_behaviours: Chooses mentoring/care/education activities; enjoys interpersonal helping work.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Preference for social/helping work, not empathic capacity or cooperative trait.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC inventories.
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: As P045: interest is not ability or suitability proof.

operational_definition: Interest in managing, persuading, selling, leading or initiating business/political ventures.
observable_behaviours: Chooses enterprise/sales/leadership ventures; enjoys influencing and initiating projects.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Preference for enterprising work, not leadership tendency, assertiveness trait, or sales competence.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC inventories.
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: As P045: interest is not ability.

operational_definition: Interest in organised, data- and procedure-based work following clear rules and routines.
observable_behaviours: Chooses accounting/data/administrative activities; enjoys organising information accurately.
distinction_from_related_constructs: Preference for conventional work, not conscientiousness, ability with data, or valuing security alone.
assessment_approaches: O*NET Interest Profiler / validated RIASEC inventories.
measurement_cautions: Measures preference/fit, not ability or performance potential; use for guidance/matching hypotheses, not screening out.
limitations: As P045: interest is not ability.
